summary: Decode collection-scoped membership metadata and refusals in generated clients

replay.detail: No replay or projection rebuild is required.

schema.detail: The additive client wire contract describes opt-in page and stream metadata; canonical graph schemas are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Rust, Swift and TypeScript retain legacy decoding and expose optional collection contract and epoch metadata. Collection-v1 schema validation requires epoch metadata and preserves the exact refusal codes. No capability is advertised yet.

recovery.detail: Malformed selected metadata is rejected by the shared wire schema instead of being mistaken for a legacy response.
